jobs.title: Support Engineer
jobs.description_text:
Position Overview

Our customers are at the forefront of some of the most interesting data in the world, using SingleStore to push the boundaries every day. To do this well, they leverage the expertise of our Support Engineering Team, composed of technical subject matter experts on the frontline of critical customer issues. 

This Support Engineering role skews far more towards engineering than typical technical support as you will need to delve into database internals and memory allocators, investigate Linux and host-related configurations, and diagnose SQL query behaviour, all in the name of resolving complex database issues. Our Support Engineers are constantly learning a wide range of customer systems and technical concepts and are thrilled by the new and exciting challenges that they encounter on a regular basis. 

To accurately identify the source and solution of an issue, this team will take the time to learn about the customer’s business and systems while helping to improve their fundamental SingleStore and database operational knowledge. This often requires additional research and time spent on learning new technologies and tools outside of SingleStore while also being deeply engaged with multiple departments including development teams, query performance engineering, product management, infrastructure SREs, etc.

Your work will protect the identities and access that support Scopely’s critical business processes, including essential enterprise functions and game operations.  This is a highly technical, hands-on role for someone who can operate across AWS, GCP, Okta, AWS IAM Identity Center, Zero Trust access models, identity governance workflows, and modern AI-enabled engineering environments, while building scalable identity systems through Infrastructure as Code, workflow orchestration, and automation-first security engineering.

What You Will Do

Reduce identity attack surface and privilege

  • Reduce standing and excessive access with least-privilege roles, just-in-time and time-bound elevation, and automated access reviews.
  • Build repeatable identity and access workflows that make onboarding, approvals, role changes, review

jobs.description_text:
Company Overview:

Strand Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering programmable mRNA therapeutics to unlock the full potential of genetic medicines. Strand is applying its proprietary Signal Stack platform, which integrates EverScript circular RNA, AmpliScript self-replicating RNA, SignalPath targeted delivery, and logic-driven SignalLock genetic circuits to enable precise control of therapeutic activity across tissues and cell types and overcome foundational limitations in targeting, durability, and safety.

Strand is advancing a pipeline with an initial focus on oncology and autoimmune disease. Its initial program, STX-001, an intratumorally delivered LNP-encapsulated self-replicating RNA expressing IL-12, has demonstrated preliminary evidence of systemic immune activation and anti-tumor activity in patients with advanced solid tumors who have progressed on prior therapies. Building on this early clinical validation, intravenously delivered STX-003 is designed for tumor-targeted expression and avoidance of off-target expression. STX-003, which is expected to enter the clinic in mid-2026, has the potential to be a major step forward for the fields of genetic medicine and oncology. jobs.title: (Senior/Junior AI Inference Reliability Engineer, Compute Infra
jobs.description_text:
About the Role

We're looking for a software engineer, reliability-minded but still a builder, to own what happens in production to the Kubernetes-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. The platform team builds the manifest-driven API and controllers that let the inference team declare what they need, a cluster, a model deployment, a capacity change, and get it reconciled underneath. Your job is to keep that promise true in the real world: triaging InfiniBand issues when prefill and decode nodes stall exchanging KV cache over RDMA, diagnosing hero-model and LoRA-serving faults that don't show up in generic health checks, and extending the automated self-healing system so each new failure mode becomes a permanent fix instead of a recurring page.

The core value we're after is keeping the decoupling real even when things break, and keeping the fleet efficient without that efficiency becoming a new source of instability. You'll own SLOs and error budgets for inference serving, lead incident response, and turn what postmortems teach you into actual changes in the controllers and automation, not just updated runbooks. You'll also work the reliability side of capacity efficiency, since a mistuned defragmentation or bin-packing pass is itself a production risk. Strong candidates have hands-on production-reliability experience on large-scale distributed or GPU-serving systems, are comfortable troubleshooting InfiniBand

Virtu is a leading financial firm that leverages cutting-edge technology to deliver liquidity to the global markets and innovative, transparent trading solutions to our clients. As a market maker, Virtu provides deep liquidity that helps to create more efficient markets around the world. Virtu's Risk Management team is a globally connected and fast-paced group, responsible for the framework that routes retail equity orders to market. Sitting at the intersection of trading and engineering, the team plays a central role in how Virtu manages risk in real time, across markets and around the clock.

In this role, you'll support live systems, acting as the first line of defense, thinking like a trader when markets move, and like an engineer when the system needs to evolve. It's a hands-on, coding-intensive role with real ownership over production systems, that blends disciplined risk management with the deeper work of building and improving the systems behind it.

jobs.description_text: Our Platform Services team builds secure, scalable backend systems and foundational infrastructure that everything else is built on. Their work powers our member experiences and strengthens the technical backbone our customers depend on. Our tech stack leverages microservices built with Python and Go, running on GCP and Kubernetes. We're creating smoother, smarter, and more delightful experiences for our users, and we're solving real engineering problems at scale.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description_text: Achievers is an employee recognition and engagement platform, and our mission is to Change the Way the World Works. We help companies celebrate great work, build stronger cultures, and make sure people feel valued. Every day, our platform powers millions of recognition moments for global, multi-generational workforces. As a Product Designer in our Member Experience domain, you will be the full-time designer for our Campaigns and Recognition teams, working alongside the Product Managers and engineers on each. You will design the experiences people use to recognize one another and the experiences our customers use to run campaigns, from the first question about the problem through to shipped work and what we learn from it. The work spans web and mobile and is built on our design system. You will work within an agile team, take on well-defined design work, bring your own ideas to how it gets solved, and grow your skills with support from the senior designers on the team. Learn more about our platform: https://www.achievers.com/platform/

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Analytics and Reporting Solutions ⭐
jobs.description_text: Our Data Intelligence team builds backend services that turn data from our SaaS platform into high-value, actionable insights for our customers. We’re transforming the way data is used at Achievers, delivering high-impact, intelligent services that redefine how work gets done. Our tech stack leverages microservices built with Python and Go, running on GCP and Kubernetes. We're creating smoother, smarter, and more delightful experiences for our users, and we're solving real engineering problems at scale. As a Staff Engineer, you'll help shape the technical direction of the platform, lead complex system initiatives, and play a key role in evolving our architecture, engineering practices, and data strategy.

jobs.title: Product Specialist (Cloud Support SME)
jobs.description_text: ABOUT US Acceldata is the market leader in Enterprise Data Observability. Founded in 2018 and backed by top investors including Insight Partners, March Capital, Lightspeed, Sorenson Ventures, Industry Ventures, and Emergent Ventures, we are a Series-C funded company headquartered in Silicon Valley. Our Enterprise Data Observability Platform—the first of its kind—helps enterprises build and operate world-class data products by ensuring data is reliable, trusted, and ready to power today’s most critical technologies, including AI, LLMs, Analytics, and DataOps. Delivered as a SaaS solution, Acceldata is trusted by leading global organizations such as HPE, HSBC, Visa, Freddie Mac, Manulife, Workday, Oracle, PubMatic, PhonePe (Walmart), Hershey’s, Dun & Bradstreet, and many more. Position Summary: As a Product Specialist, you will join a team of highly skilled engineers who thrive on tackling new and impactful challenges, shaping the future of Acceldata’s support services. In this collaborative and dynamic environment, you will leverage your business acumen, technical expertise, and interpersonal skills to make a tangible difference for our valued customers. As one of the first Product Specialists, you will play a critical role in creating meaningful solutions while actively listening and empathizing with customers who are navigating complex product issues.

jobs.title: Senior SDET - Open Data Platform (ODP)
jobs.description_text: Acceldata Open Data Platform (ODP) is an enterprise-grade, fully integrated data platform that packages, validates, and supports a curated set of open-source data components as a unified, production-ready distribution. ODP delivers tested, co-versioned component stacks with validated interoperability, security hardening, and a single support contract. It is purpose-built for on-premises data centers, private clouds, and hybrid environments. Product Link : https://www.acceldata.io/open-data-platform Documentation : https://docs.acceldata.io/odp

jobs.title: Staff Product Support Engineer - Cloud Support
jobs.description_text: As a Staff Product Support Engineer / Product Specialist (Cloud Support SME) at Acceldata, You will take on a pivotal role with higher accountability in swiftly resolving complex customer challenges in two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one. You will focus on delivering faster resolutions and ensuring seamless operations resolution, enabling customers to monitor, predict, and optimize their data systems for impactful business outcomes. If you’re passionate about working in fast-paced, dynamic environments and want to be part of the cutting edge of data solutions, this role is for you.

jobs.description_text: About the Role As an Applied Research Engineer, you’ll build practical AI research assets that support Frontier lab initiatives and customer engagements. This is an implementation-focused role for someone who enjoys turning research concepts into working systems. You’ll work with a high degree of autonomy, experimenting with new approaches and developing solutions that can be reused across customer opportunities. You’ll partner closely with the GenAI Research team and cross-functional stakeholders to bring technical ideas into practical applications. Develop benchmarks and evaluation harnesses to measure model and data quality across areas such as accuracy, robustness, safety, latency, and cost. Build LLM pipelines and agentic systems that support research, evaluation, and customer trials. Run fine-tuning, adapter, and other model experiments to evaluate how data and methods influence model behavior. Deploy local or self-hosted models for evaluation, inference, and automation workflows. Document experiments, configurations, data, results, and known limitations so other engineers can reproduce and build on your work. jobs.title: IT Security Analyst - India
jobs.description_text: About the Role The IT Security Analyst protects the organization's information assets by operating and improving our security controls. The role owns security operations across Microsoft Defender, leads incident response, maintains ISO 27001 documentation, and drives identity, access and patch management. ISO 27001: Maintain ISMS policies, risk register and audit evidence; support internal and external audits and close findings. IAM & Access Reviews: Administer Entra ID (Conditional Access, MFA); run quarterly user and privileged access reviews and enforce least privilege. PAM: Operate the Privileged Access Management solution, including PIM and break-glass accounts. Patch & Vulnerability Management: Own vulnerability remediation and monthly patch cycles; report compliance against SLAs. Cost Optimisation: Manage security licences and Sentinel log ingestion to optimise cost without reducing coverage. What You Bring 1–3 years' experience in a security operations or security analyst role. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender XDR, Sentinel and Entra ID. Experience leading security incidents and producing incident reports. Working knowledge of ISO
